Destination extent. The Nikon tag decoder allocates a 200-byte heap buffer for generic text values. The saved ASan allocation stack points to this constructor and later reports the over-read at the first byte past this 200-byte region.

Entered with `size_external == 24`, the decoder starts a fixed 100-iteration record loop. The loop body never decrements or checks `size_external`; the parameter is only used by the cleanup seek at line 1052 after the loop, so the first record can read past the declared `NCTG` payload before any rewind happens.

The next two bytes `00 02` set `dataType == 2`, selecting the text-value decoder rather than the numeric arms.
